scope: pinned MT7603/Linux 4.4.198 source audit of radio-on, debug reset and periodic PSE reset producer paths; source-only

findings.path: radio-on and debug reset through WEXT private ioctl
findings.fact: WEXT dispatch holds RTNL across the complete driver handler. Set_RadioOn_Proc calls MlmeRadioOn; Set_PDMAWatchDog_Proc with Dbg=2 calls PDMAResetAndRecovery.
findings.limit: The RTNL rendezvous alone does not exclude later WEXT handlers. Correction: candidate v39 already wraps PDMA/PSE reset with retirement-aware request/begin checks and rtnl_trylock; Set_RadioOn_Proc remains outside that admission protocol.

findings.fact: The periodic timer callback enqueues CMDTHREAD_MLME_PERIOIDC_EXEC. With DMA_RESET_SUPPORT, PDMAWatchDog sets pse_reset_flag instead of calling PDMAResetAndRecovery; PSEWatchDog may call PSEResetAndRecovery from the management-command execution path.
findings.limit: The timer and command worker run outside RTNL, but candidate raw PSE/PDMA execution enters the retirement-aware reset wrapper and holds RTNL when admitted. Joining the whole periodic callback and command worker remains a separate lifetime requirement; do not describe raw reset execution as unguarded.

findings.fact: The close path exits net tasklets, calls MlmeHalt (kills MLME task and cancels periodic timer), then exits the management command task; the command-task exit marks CmdQ stopped and kills the task.
findings.limit: This documents shutdown primitives, not that they run before the PCI remove candidate's first terminal hardware action or that every callback has completed successfully.

early_rtnl_barrier_is_sufficient_for: joining currently executing ordinary ndo_open callbacks
joining currently executing WEXT handlers that hold RTNL
early_rtnl_barrier_is_not_sufficient_for: excluding new RadioOn ioctls after the barrier releases
joining asynchronous MLME/PSE watchdog work outside RTNL
proving DMA, IRQ, timer, command-queue or callback quiescence
conclusion.next_required_design: Guard WEXT RadioOn admission against retirement, relying on the verified RTNL handler lifetime for the admitted call; verify current composed reset wrappers before changing reset execution. Separately establish complete timer/command-worker callback joins.

candidate_correction.scope: checked-in v39 source; latest full composition must be revalidated
candidate_correction.reset_gate: request_reset_kind rejects retiring; radio_begin rejects RESET while retiring; admitted reset drain holds RTNL through raw execution
candidate_correction.radio_on_gap: Set_RadioOn_Proc directly calls MlmeRadioOn without retirement admission
